# Richard Vibert

Richard Vibert is the current Connétable of [St Peter](https://flow.je/elections/st-peter) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2018.

Richard Vibert has participated in 2 elections since 2002:

- [**2018 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/richard-vibert#e43)

  Elected as Connétable of St Peter unopposed.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/richard-vibert-2/)
- [**2022 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/richard-vibert#e49)

  Elected as Connétable of St Peter.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/richard-vibert/)

Richard Vibert has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Connétables Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [St Peter](https://flow.je/elections/st-peter). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/20/constable-declares-intention-to-seek-re-election-for-third-term/)\]

**Richard Vibert was elected as Connétable of St Peter in 2018 unopposed**.
